title: Italian Tuna, Cannellini Bean and Red Onion Salad
summary: A quick Italian-style lunch salad with flaky tuna, creamy cannellini beans, sharp red onion, parsley and a bright lemon-olive oil dressing. It is fresh, filling and ideal for a no-cook weekday meal.
steps: Put the sliced red onion in a small bowl with 1 tablespoon of the lemon juice and a pinch of the salt. Toss and leave for 5 minutes to soften its sharpness.
In a large bowl, whisk the olive oil with the remaining lemon juice, dried oregano, salt and black pepper until glossy and combined.
Add the cannellini beans, cherry tomatoes, capers and parsley to the dressing. Toss gently so the beans stay mostly whole and everything is coated.
Flake in the drained tuna in large pieces and add the softened red onion with its lemony juices. Fold gently to combine without breaking up the tuna too much.
Arrange the rocket on plates or in shallow bowls, spoon the tuna and bean salad over the top, and serve immediately.
